issue.title: Record inbox answers routing first as an accepted decision
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-4q.4 note #1, required by the approved epic's docs-and-rollout step 6. The delivered feature (bob-plugins bff5585/73cd4b0/3689d34; bob-cli docs ade4b8a) is documented, but the decisions roster has no inbox-routing record and glossary:area-note still mentions only Ctrl+Shift+M for task filing. Add an immutable decisions/inbox-answers-route-first.md strand recording the approved inbox contract: on an open task in inbox.md or a direct area child, non-closing Ctrl+Shift+P commits and cursor-task Ctrl+Shift+Enter prompt last, act then move, never follow, and advance as answers only when moved. Ctrl+Shift+M keeps following and parking. Record the rejected alternatives and reasons from plan:202610/inbox_routing.md (route first, move first, write before prompt, rebuilding an in-card stage, per-key config); explain the stay escape hatch and close exclusions. Add one sentence to glossary/area-note.md about these inbox-routing gestures. Follow decisions-web conventions; do not rewrite accepted records. Obtain required memory approval and run sase memory init when implemented. This task records the accepted design; it must not redesign the feature or alter sticky lanes. bob-cli-4n is adjacent glossary containment work, not a duplicate.
